semantics.authorization: no objective-write authorization required or accepted; family/schedule/timing validation instead
semantics.full_reset_exception: declared reset-target allowlist; backward or out-of-schedule family members only if pre-declared; fresh independent single-version schedule; parent sealed
semantics.lifecycle: single-line control: predecessor sealed, one active path, unique shared budget/ledger
semantics.mandatory_cohort_boundary: once a frozen switch is due, the old cohort cannot commit another period before the scheduled exogenous transition; declaration tampering cannot move the boundary; rejected runs are commit-free
semantics.period_sequence: run_period accepts only period == next_period; unique, contiguous, increasing actual periods; continuity preserves the counter and full reset starts at 0; invalid periods change no state
semantics.registry_transition: exogenous frozen evaluation-protocol event, not a policy action
semantics.rejection_state_effect: registry, objective store, budget, and active path unchanged; only a rejection audit record appended; zero resource spend
semantics.rollback_interaction: objective rollback never restores a registry version; continuity transitions append-only forward
semantics.switch_timing: frozen switch_after_period per scheduled successor, fixed before any arm result is read; early, late, duplicate-counting, and tampered-timing attempts rejected
